description:
## Problem
On #4340 at d62a5dd6bb: results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md gives peak memory of about 0.7 GB for Doris SF 0.01 (c2022935) and about 600 MB for LakeSail (312e8b59); the traces peak at 2.26 GB and 2.16 GB. The discard list omits two completed, validated 4 GiB default-parallelism runs (065c109b, power 22.7 s; e5792f56, power 24.7 s, load 46.7 s) and describes the completed 3 GiB runs as attempts; every published Doris number is the fastest of its set. The 'started only once the 1-minute load fell below 5' claim has no artifact (the bundle's start sample is 5.9) and the rule was applied only to SF 0.1; the published SF 0.01 run was admitted at a 5-minute load of 40.45 and 96.4% swap. The note says the 2026-11-11 capped runs' container memory is not known; it was 4 GiB. `defective-nondefault-engine-config` reads 'ran with an engine setting that is not the platform's default', which also describes the replacements (the adapter raises exec_mem_limit from 2 GiB to 5 GiB). The body claims 1290 tests passed with no evidence.

## Change
Correct the peaks from the mem.log traces; list every discarded run with its timings, host load and reason; state one discard rule and show how each published and discarded run meets it, or say plainly where it was not applied; state 4 GiB for the capped runs; reword the label text to name the parallelism cap; remove unsupported claims from the body. Raw runs are in ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/doris-lakesail-rerun/.

## Decision gates
Decided by the owner on 2026-11-20 (see context): label id `defective-capped-engine-parallelism` with the recorded text; keep the three published bundles with the full disclosure; no reruns. The note already says no uniform load rule was applied; do not invent one.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the pull request body lists, for each memory figure, the mem.log line it comes from (path, timestamp, value, file sha256), because the raw directory is local only; the body cites a preflight receipt for the head tree; the discard list equals the set of completed runs not published; the inventory and seed checks pass with unchanged bundle bytes.

## Additions from the item review
- Review threads D1 to D8 on #4340 were resolved by the author without re-review; a reviewer re-verifies each.
- Check how the deployed Explorer renders the new defect id and that the superseded bundles leave rankings.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
